name: Barbell Bench Press
cue: Pin shoulder blades back; touch low chest; drive feet into the floor.

name: Paused Bench Press
cue: Hold a still one-count pause on the chest, then press without bouncing.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
cue: Lock legs in; lower to the lower chest and press back over the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cue: Lower to chest level for a deep stretch; press up and slightly in.

name: Decline Dumbbell Press
cue: Keep shoulders pinned to the bench; lower wide and press to lockout.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Bench Press
cue: Brace hard so hips stay level; lower to a full stretch and press.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
cue: Let upper arms touch the floor softly, pause, then press.

name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
cue: Press the dumbbells together hard the whole rep as you lower and press.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
cue: Set the bench so the bar lands on low chest; stack wrists over elbows.

name: Machine Chest Press
cue: Set handles at mid-chest; keep shoulder blades back and press smoothly.

name: Plate-Loaded Chest Press
cue: Adjust the seat so handles line up with mid-chest; drive through the palms.

name: Plate-Loaded Decline Press
cue: Drive the handles down and forward along the arc; keep shoulders pinned.

name: Cable Chest Press
cue: Stagger your stance; press handles forward and together at chest height.

name: Push-Up
cue: Hold a straight line from head to heels; lower until the chest nearly touches.

name: Deficit Push-Up
cue: Hands on handles or plates so the chest sinks below hand level.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
cue: Set the bench near 30°; lower to the upper chest with elbows slightly tucked.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
cue: Bench at 30–45°; lower to a deep stretch beside the upper chest, then press.

name: Low-Incline Dumbbell Press
cue: Bench at 15–20°; keep elbows about 45° from the torso; control the stretch.

name: Smith Machine Incline Press
cue: Position the bench so the bar touches the upper chest; control each descent.

name: Incline Machine Chest Press
cue: Keep the chest up and shoulders down; take a full stretch at the bottom.

name: Plate-Loaded Incline Press
cue: Keep the upper back tight on the pad; let hands travel back for a deep stretch.

name: Pec Deck
cue: Keep a slight elbow bend; squeeze the handles together and control the stretch.

name: Cable Crossover
cue: Pulleys high; sweep hands down and together in front of the hips.

name: Cable Fly
cue: Pulleys at shoulder height; hug a wide arc and meet hands at mid-chest.

name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
cue: Pulleys low; scoop hands up and in to upper-chest height, palms up.

name: Single-Arm Cable Fly
cue: Stand side-on; sweep one arm across the body just past the midline.

name: Incline Cable Fly
cue: Bench at 30° between low pulleys; open wide, then bring hands over upper chest.

name: Dumbbell Fly
cue: Soft elbows; lower in a wide arc until the chest stretches, then hug up.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
cue: Bench at 30°; open wide with a fixed elbow bend; stop before dumbbells touch.

name: Chest Dip
cue: Lean forward, let elbows flare slightly, and descend until the chest stretches.

name: Assisted Dip
cue: Kneel on the pad; lower until shoulders dip below elbows, then press up.

name: Barbell Row
cue: Hinge to about 45°, brace, and row the bar to the lower ribs.

name: Pendlay Row
cue: Torso near parallel; pull each rep explosively from a dead stop on the floor.

name: Underhand Barbell Row
cue: Supinated grip, torso fairly upright; drive the elbows back toward the hips.

name: T-Bar Row
cue: Straddle the bar, hinge with a flat back, and pull the handle to the chest.

name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
cue: Keep the chest glued to the pad; drive elbows back and squeeze the shoulder blades.

name: Barbell Seal Row
cue: Lie prone on a high bench; row the bar to the bench without lifting the chest.

name: Dumbbell Seal Row
cue: Lie flat on a raised bench and row both dumbbells up, elbows at about 45°.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
cue: Chest on an incline bench; let the shoulder blades reach, then row.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
cue: Brace on a bench; pull the dumbbell toward the hip, not straight up.

name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
cue: Hinge with a neutral spine and row both dumbbells to the lower ribs.

name: Meadows Row
cue: Stand perpendicular to a landmine; row the sleeve high with the elbow flared.

name: Seated Cable Row
cue: Sit tall, let the shoulders reach forward, then pull the handle to the stomach.

name: Wide-Grip Cable Row
cue: Use a wide bar, flare the elbows, and pull to the lower chest.

name: Single-Arm Cable Row
cue: Reach long at the front, then drive the elbow back past the torso.

name: Seated Row Machine
cue: Chest on the pad; pull until elbows pass the torso, then reach forward.

name: Plate-Loaded Row
cue: Keep the chest on the pad and row each handle to the side of the ribs.

name: Plate-Loaded Low Row
cue: Pull low and toward the hips, keeping the elbows close to the body.

name: Smith Machine Row
cue: Hinge with a flat back; pull the bar to the lower ribs along the track.

name: Inverted Row
cue: Body rigid like a plank; pull the chest to the bar and lower under control.

name: Band Row
cue: Anchor the band at chest height; squeeze the shoulder blades as elbows go back.

name: Lat Pulldown
cue: Thighs locked under the pad; pull the bar to the upper chest, elbows to your sides.

name: Close-Grip Pulldown
cue: Lean back slightly and pull the handle to the chest with elbows tight.

name: Neutral-Grip Pulldown
cue: Use a wide parallel-grip bar; drive the elbows down toward the back pockets.

name: Underhand Pulldown
cue: Shoulder-width underhand grip; pull to the upper chest, elbows in front.

name: Single-Arm Cable Pulldown
cue: Reach high for a full stretch, then pull the elbow down to the hip.

name: Machine Pulldown
cue: Set the pad snug on the thighs; pull handles to the shoulders and control the rise.

name: Plate-Loaded Pulldown
cue: Lean slightly into the stretch, then pull the elbows down and back.

name: Plate-Loaded High Row
cue: Pull the handles down and back toward the hips; stretch fully at the top.

name: Pull-Up
cue: Start from a dead hang; pull the chest toward the bar without kipping.

name: Chin-Up
cue: Palms facing you, shoulder-width; pull until the chin clears the bar.

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
cue: Palms facing each other; lead with the chest and control the descent.

name: Assisted Pull-Up
cue: Use enough assistance to reach full range with a smooth tempo.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
cue: Hinge slightly with arms nearly straight; sweep the bar or rope to the thighs.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
cue: Lower the dumbbell behind the head with soft elbows until the lats stretch.

name: Machine Pullover
cue: Drive through the elbow pads in an arc until the bar reaches the stomach.

name: Barbell Shrug
cue: Stand tall and lift the shoulders straight up toward the ears; pause briefly.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
cue: Dumbbells at your sides; shrug straight up, hold a beat, lower slowly.

name: Incline Dumbbell Shrug
cue: Chest down on an incline bench; pull the shoulder blades up and together.

name: Smith Machine Shrug
cue: Stand close to the bar; lift the shoulders straight up without rolling them.

name: Trap Bar Shrug
cue: Stand in the center of the bar and shrug high with the arms long.

name: Machine Shrug
cue: Keep the arms relaxed like hooks; lift from the traps, not the biceps.

name: Cable Shrug
cue: Stand between low pulleys; shrug up and slightly back, pausing at the top.

name: Overhead Press
cue: Squeeze the glutes, press in a straight line, and push the head through at lockout.

name: Seated Barbell Overhead Press
cue: Sit upright with the back supported; lower to the chin and press overhead.

name: Push Press
cue: Dip a few inches at the knees, drive up, and finish the press with the arms.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cue: Lower until the dumbbells reach ear level; press up without clanking them.

name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cue: Brace abs and glutes; press straight up without leaning back.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cue: Resist leaning sideways; press one dumbbell straight overhead.

name: Arnold Press
cue: Start with palms facing you; rotate them outward as you press overhead.

name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
cue: Set the bench slightly behind the bar path; lower to chin level and press.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
cue: Seat so the handles start at shoulder height; press up without shrugging.

name: Plate-Loaded Shoulder Press
cue: Keep the back on the pad and ribs down; press through the full range.

name: Landmine Press
cue: Hold the sleeve at the shoulder and press up and forward along the arc.

name: Pike Push-Up
cue: Hips high; lower the head just ahead of the hands, then press back up.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
cue: Raise to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend; lower slowly.

name: Cable Front Raise
cue: Face away from a low pulley; raise the handle to eye level with a long arm.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cue: Lead with the elbows and raise out to the sides to shoulder height, no swing.

name: Seated Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cue: Sit tall to remove momentum; raise out and slightly forward.

name: Lean-Away Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cue: Hold a post and lean away; raise the dumbbell out to the side.

name: Lying Incline Lateral Raise
cue: Lie on your side on an incline bench; raise the arm up in a wide arc.

name: Dumbbell Y-Raise
cue: Chest on an incline bench; raise the dumbbells in a Y with thumbs up.

name: Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raise
cue: Set the pulley near hip height; sweep the handle out to shoulder level.

name: Lean-Away Cable Lateral Raise
cue: Hold the frame and lean away; raise from the low pulley out to the side.

name: Behind-the-Back Cable Lateral Raise
cue: Run the cable behind your back from the far side; raise the arm out wide.

name: Cable Y-Raise
cue: Cross the low cables and raise the hands up and out into a wide Y.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
cue: Align shoulders with the pivot; drive the elbows out and up against the pads.

name: Band Lateral Raise
cue: Stand on the band; raise the arms out to the sides and control the return.

name: Barbell Upright Row
cue: Grip wider than the shoulders and lift the elbows to shoulder height.

name: Cable Upright Row
cue: Wide grip; pull the elbows up and out to shoulder height, bar close.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
cue: Lead with the elbows, pulling the dumbbells up the front of the body.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
cue: Arms slightly bent; sweep the handles back wide without pinching the blades.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
cue: Cross the cables at shoulder height and pull the hands apart in a wide arc.

name: Single-Arm Cable Rear Delt Fly
cue: Pull across the body from the opposite pulley, moving the arm out and back.

name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Reverse Fly
cue: Hinge forward and raise the dumbbells out wide, pinkies leading.

name: Chest-Supported Reverse Fly
cue: Chest on an incline bench; raise the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Row
cue: Flare the elbow to 90° and row the dumbbell toward the upper chest.

name: Band Pull-Apart
cue: Arms straight at shoulder height; pull the band apart until it meets the chest.

name: Face Pull
cue: Pull the rope toward the eyes, splitting the ends and rotating the hands back.

name: Band Face Pull
cue: Anchor the band at face height; pull and spread the hands beside the ears.

name: Barbell Curl
cue: Pin the elbows at your sides; curl without swinging the torso.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
cue: Hold the angled grips; curl up and lower all the way under control.

name: EZ-Bar Preacher Curl
cue: Armpits snug on the pad; lower until the arms are nearly straight.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl
cue: Brace the upper arm on the pad and curl through a full stretch.

name: Machine Preacher Curl
cue: Line the elbows up with the pivot; curl hard and resist on the way down.

name: Dumbbell Curl
cue: Turn the palms up as you curl; keep the elbows still near your sides.

name: Hammer Curl
cue: Palms face each other; curl without letting the elbows drift forward.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
cue: Curl each dumbbell across the body toward the opposite shoulder.

name: Cable Rope Hammer Curl
cue: Neutral grip on the rope; curl up and pull the ends apart at the top.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
cue: Bench at 45–60°; let the arms hang behind the torso for a deep stretch.

name: Concentration Curl
cue: Brace the elbow on the inner thigh; curl and squeeze without moving the arm.

name: Dumbbell Spider Curl
cue: Chest on an incline bench, arms hanging straight down; curl with no swing.

name: EZ-Bar Spider Curl
cue: Lie chest-down on an incline bench and curl the bar with arms vertical.

name: Cable Curl
cue: Stand close to a low pulley; curl with the elbows fixed at your sides.

name: Single-Arm Cable Curl
cue: Face the pulley and curl one handle while holding the elbow still.

name: Bayesian Cable Curl
cue: Face away from the pulley; let the arm trail behind you, then curl.

name: Overhead Cable Curl
cue: Arms out at shoulder height between high pulleys; curl hands toward the head.

name: Zottman Curl
cue: Curl palms up, rotate palms down at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Band Curl
cue: Stand on the band and curl, squeezing hard where the tension peaks.

name: Rope Pushdown
cue: Elbows pinned to your sides; push down and spread the rope at the bottom.

name: Bar Pushdown
cue: Lean slightly forward, keep the elbows still, and press the bar to the thighs.

name: Single-Arm Cable Pushdown
cue: Use a single handle; extend fully with the elbow tucked at your side.

name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
cue: Face away from the pulley; let the rope reach behind the head, then extend.

name: Single-Arm Overhead Cable Extension
cue: Point the elbow up; lower the handle behind the head and extend fully.

name: Cross-Body Cable Extension
cue: Pull from the opposite high pulley and extend the arm across the body.

name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
cue: Lower the bar just behind the head with the elbows angled slightly back.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
cue: Palms facing in; lower the dumbbells beside the head, then extend.

name: EZ-Bar Overhead Triceps Extension
cue: Keep the elbows narrow; lower the bar behind the head for a deep stretch.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
cue: Cup one dumbbell with both hands; lower it deep behind the head, then extend.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Overhead Extension
cue: Keep the elbow pointing up; lower behind the head and press to lockout.

name: JM Press
cue: Lower the bar toward the chin by letting the elbows travel forward; press up.

name: Smith Machine JM Press
cue: Let the elbows drift forward as the bar drops toward the upper chest.

name: Machine Triceps Extension
cue: Align the elbows with the pivot; extend fully and resist on the way back.

name: Dumbbell Kickback
cue: Upper arm parallel to the floor; straighten the elbow without swinging.

name: Cable Triceps Kickback
cue: Hinge forward with the upper arm by your side; extend the handle straight back.

name: Band Pushdown
cue: Anchor the band high; extend down with the elbows fixed at your sides.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
cue: Hands about shoulder-width, elbows tucked; touch the lower chest and press.

name: Smith Machine Close-Grip Bench Press
cue: Narrow grip and tucked elbows; lower to the sternum along the track.

name: Diamond Push-Up
cue: Hands together under the chest; keep the elbows close as you lower.

name: Triceps Dip
cue: Stay upright with elbows back; lower to about 90° and lock out fully.

name: Bench Dip
cue: Hands on a bench behind you; lower until the elbows reach 90°, then press.

name: Seated Dip Machine
cue: Sit tall, push the handles down to full lockout, and control the rise.

name: EZ-Bar Reverse Curl
cue: Overhand grip; curl with the wrists straight and the elbows at your sides.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Curl
cue: Palms down; curl both dumbbells up without letting the wrists drop.

name: Cable Reverse Curl
cue: Overhand grip on a straight bar; curl slowly and keep the knuckles up.

name: Barbell Wrist Curl
cue: Forearms on the thighs, palms up; let the bar roll to the fingers, then curl.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
cue: Rest the forearm on a bench, palm up; curl the wrist through its full range.

name: Barbell Reverse Wrist Curl
cue: Palms down over the knees; lift the knuckles and lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl
cue: Palm down with the forearm supported; raise the back of the hand toward you.

name: Cable Wrist Curl
cue: Kneel at a low pulley with forearms on a bench; curl the handle up.

name: Behind-the-Back Wrist Curl
cue: Hold the bar behind your hips and curl it up using only the wrists.

name: Barbell Back Squat
cue: Brace, sit down between the hips, and keep the knees tracking over the toes.

name: High-Bar Back Squat
cue: Bar on the traps, torso upright; squat deep with the knees traveling forward.

name: Low-Bar Back Squat
cue: Bar below the traps; lean slightly more and push the floor away.

name: Pause Squat
cue: Hold two seconds in the hole while staying tight, then drive up.

name: Barbell Front Squat
cue: Elbows high, torso upright; sit straight down between the heels.

name: Safety Bar Squat
cue: Hold the handles and keep the chest up against the bar's forward pull.

name: Smith Machine Squat
cue: Feet slightly ahead of the bar; descend deep with a vertical torso.

name: Hack Squat
cue: Back flat on the pad; lower until the thighs pass parallel, knees forward.

name: Reverse Hack Squat
cue: Face the pad, push the hips back, and drive up through the whole foot.

name: Pendulum Squat
cue: Shoulders under the pads; sink as deep as possible and drive through midfoot.

name: Belt Squat
cue: Belt on the hips, torso upright; squat deep with no load on the spine.

name: V-Squat
cue: Shoulders under the pads; control the descent and push through the heels.

name: Goblet Squat
cue: Hold the weight at the chest; sit between the knees with elbows inside them.

name: Bodyweight Squat
cue: Sit down between the heels at a steady tempo; pause briefly at the bottom.

name: Pistol Squat
cue: Hold the free leg out in front; sit to a box or door frame until you own the depth.

name: Leg Press
cue: Lower until the knees are deep while the hips stay down on the seat.

name: Seated Leg Press
cue: Back flat on the pad; bring the knees toward the chest and press out.

name: Single-Leg Leg Press
cue: One foot centered on the platform; lower slowly with the hip staying down.

name: High-Foot Leg Press
cue: Place the feet high and wide; drive through the heels without the hips lifting.

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
cue: Rear foot on a bench; drop the back knee straight down, front foot flat.

name: Smith Machine Bulgarian Split Squat
cue: Rear foot on a bench behind the bar; lower straight down along the track.

name: Dumbbell Split Squat
cue: Staggered stance, feet hip-width; lower the back knee toward the floor.

name: Smith Machine Split Squat
cue: Front foot ahead of the bar; sink the back knee down and drive up evenly.

name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
cue: Take long steps and lower the rear knee gently toward the floor.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
cue: Step back and drop the rear knee; push through the front heel to return.

name: Deficit Reverse Lunge
cue: Stand on a low step and reach back deep so the front hip fully flexes.

name: Barbell Reverse Lunge
cue: Brace with the bar on the traps and step back into each rep under control.

name: Smith Machine Reverse Lunge
cue: Step one foot back under the bar and lower straight down.

name: Dumbbell Forward Lunge
cue: Step forward, lower to a controlled depth, and push back to standing.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
cue: Plant the whole foot on the box and stand up without pushing off the back leg.

name: Bodyweight Bulgarian Split Squat
cue: Rear foot on a chair or bed; lower slowly and keep the front heel down.

name: Bodyweight Reverse Lunge
cue: Step back long enough that the front shin stays upright; drive through the front foot.

name: Leg Extension
cue: Align the knee with the pivot; kick up to lockout and lower slowly.

name: Single-Leg Leg Extension
cue: Work one leg at a time; pause briefly with the knee fully straight.

name: Sissy Squat
cue: Rise onto the toes and lean back as the knees travel far forward; stand tall.

name: Reverse Nordic
cue: Kneel upright with hips straight; lean back only as far as you can control.

name: Conventional Deadlift
cue: Bar over midfoot; pull the slack out, then push the floor away.

name: Sumo Deadlift
cue: Wide stance, hands inside the knees; spread the floor and keep the chest up.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
cue: Stand centered, grip the handles, and drive up with hips and knees together.

name: Rack Pull
cue: Set the bar just below the knees; lock the hips through without leaning back.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
cue: Soft knees; push the hips back until the hamstrings stretch, bar on the thighs.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cue: Slide the dumbbells down the thighs by hinging back; keep the spine neutral.

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell RDL
cue: Hinge on one leg with the hips square; reach the dumbbell toward the floor.

name: Smith Machine RDL
cue: Stand close to the bar and push the hips back until the hamstrings stretch.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
cue: Knees nearly locked; hinge and lower the bar to mid-shin or the floor.

name: Good Morning
cue: Bar on the back, soft knees; bow forward from the hips with a flat back.

name: Cable Pull-Through
cue: Face away from a low pulley; hinge back, then snap the hips forward.

name: Kettlebell Swing
cue: Hike the bell back, then drive the hips forward so it floats to chest height.

name: 45° Back Extension
cue: Hips just above the pad; hinge down and squeeze the glutes to rise to neutral.

name: Machine Back Extension
cue: Seat the hips firmly; extend against the pad smoothly without snapping back.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
cue: Lie prone on the pad; swing the legs up to hip level using the glutes.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
cue: Upper back on a bench, chin tucked; drive the hips up until thighs are level.

name: Machine Hip Thrust
cue: Belt over the hips, feet flat; thrust up and pause at full lockout.

name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
cue: Pad the bar, set up under it, and drive straight up the track.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
cue: Hold the dumbbell on the hip crease; press through the heels to full extension.

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
cue: One foot planted, the other lifted; drive the hips up level with no twisting.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
cue: Lie on the floor with the bar on the hips; squeeze the glutes to lift, pause.

name: Glute Bridge
cue: Feet close to the hips; push through the heels and squeeze at the top.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
cue: Ankle strap on; drive the leg back and up while the lower back stays still.

name: Glute Kickback Machine
cue: Brace on the pads and push the platform back through the heel.

name: Seated Leg Curl
cue: Lock the thigh pad down, lean forward slightly, and curl the heels under.

name: Single-Leg Seated Leg Curl
cue: Curl one leg at a time with the thigh pad tight and the hips square.

name: Lying Leg Curl
cue: Hips pressed into the pad; curl the heels toward the glutes and lower slowly.

name: Standing Single-Leg Curl
cue: Brace on the frame and curl one heel up without hiking the hip.

name: Cable Leg Curl
cue: Ankle strap on a low pulley; curl the heel toward the glute.

name: Dumbbell Leg Curl
cue: Lie face down with a dumbbell between the feet; curl up and lower slowly.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
cue: Anchor the ankles, keep the hips straight, and lower as slowly as possible.

name: Glute-Ham Raise
cue: Knees behind the pad; lower with the hips straight, then curl back up.

name: Sliding Leg Curl
cue: Hold a bridge; slide the heels in and out without the hips dropping.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
cue: Start wide in a stretch; squeeze the knees together and control the return.

name: Cable Hip Adduction
cue: Strap the near ankle; sweep the leg across the body in front of you.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
cue: Sit tall or lean forward; press the knees out and control the return.

name: Cable Hip Abduction
cue: Strap the far ankle; lift the leg out to the side without leaning.

name: Banded Hip Abduction
cue: Band above the knees; push the knees apart and hold briefly.

name: Standing Calf Raise
cue: Pause in the bottom stretch, then rise as high as possible on the toes.

name: Seated Calf Raise
cue: Pad over the knees; sink the heels deep, pause, and press up fully.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
cue: Balls of the feet on the platform edge; press through a full ankle range.

name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
cue: Stand on a step under the bar; stretch deep at the bottom, then rise high.

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise
cue: Stand on a step holding a dumbbell; lower slowly and pause at the bottom.

name: Bodyweight Single-Leg Calf Raise
cue: Stand on a stair edge with a hand on the wall; full stretch, pause at the top.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
cue: Hinge forward under the pad; get a deep stretch and rise fully.

name: Cable Crunch
cue: Kneel, hold the rope by your head, and curl the ribs toward the pelvis.

name: Machine Crunch
cue: Round the spine to crunch down; do not just pull with the arms.

name: Crunch
cue: Curl the shoulders off the floor by closing the gap between ribs and hips.

name: Decline Sit-Up
cue: Hook the feet, curl up one vertebra at a time, and lower slowly.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
cue: Hang still; raise the legs by curling the pelvis up, not just the thighs.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
cue: Pull the knees toward the chest and tilt the pelvis up; avoid swinging.

name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
cue: Back against the pad; lift the knees and curl the hips off the pad.

name: Toes-to-Bar
cue: From a hang, lift the feet to touch the bar using the abs with minimal swing.

name: Lying Leg Raise
cue: Press the low back into the floor and lower straight legs without arching.

name: Reverse Crunch
cue: Curl the hips off the floor toward the ribs, then lower with control.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
cue: Keep the ribs tucked; roll out only as far as you can without the back sagging.

name: Barbell Rollout
cue: Use round plates; roll out with a hollow body and pull back with the abs.

name: Pallof Press
cue: Side-on to the pulley; press the handle out and resist being rotated.

name: Cable Woodchop
cue: Rotate through the torso, moving the handle diagonally across the body.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
cue: Hold one dumbbell; bend sideways, then pull back up using the obliques.

name: Dead Bug
cue: Low back flat; extend the opposite arm and leg slowly without arching.

name: Box Squat
cue: Sit back to the box under control, stay tight, drive up without rocking.

name: Deficit Deadlift
cue: Stand on a 3–5 cm plate; hips lower than usual, chest up, push the floor away.

name: Plank
cue: Elbows under shoulders, squeeze glutes, ribs down; a straight line head to heel.

name: Side Plank
cue: Elbow under shoulder, hips high, body in one line.

name: Dead Hang
cue: Full grip, arms straight, let the shoulders open; breathe.

name: Wall Sit
cue: Back flat on the wall, thighs parallel, knees over ankles.

name: Farmer's Carry
cue: Heavy bells, tall posture, short quick steps; set them down before the grip goes.

name: Suitcase Carry
cue: One bell, stay level; don't lean toward or away from it.

name: 90/90 Hip Switches
cue: Sit tall in 90/90, rotate both knees to the other side without hands.

name: Pigeon Stretch
cue: Front shin across, back leg long, hips square; breathe into the front hip.

name: Couch Stretch
cue: Back knee in the corner, shin up the wall; squeeze the glute, ribs down.

name: Frog Rocks
cue: Knees wide on the floor, spine long; rock hips back toward the heels and forward.

name: Hip Airplanes
cue: Hinge on one leg, rotate the pelvis open and closed under control.

name: Cossack Squat
cue: Shift into one deep side squat, other leg straight, heel down; stand and switch.

name: Squat to Stand
cue: Hold the toes, sink into a deep squat, then straighten the legs keeping hold.

name: Deep Squat Pry
cue: Sit in the bottom of a squat, elbows inside the knees; pry the knees open.

name: Knee-to-Wall Ankle Rocks
cue: Heel down, drive the knee over the little toes to the wall.

name: Banded Ankle Mobilisation
cue: Band low on the front of the ankle pulling back; rock the knee forward over the toes.

name: Elevated Calf Stretch
cue: Ball of the foot on a step, knee straight, let the heel sink.

name: Ankle CARs
cue: Hold the shin still; draw the biggest slow circle you can with the foot.

name: Front-to-Back Leg Swings
cue: Hold a wall, swing the leg forward and back, growing the range each rep.

name: Active Straight-Leg Raise
cue: On your back, lift one straight leg as high as it goes; lower slowly.

name: Hamstring Floss
cue: Seated or lying, hold behind the thigh; straighten and bend the knee with the foot flexed.

name: Bodyweight Good Morning
cue: Hands behind head, soft knees; push the hips back until the hamstrings pull.

name: Jefferson Curl
cue: Very light or no weight; roll down one vertebra at a time and roll back up.

name: Wall Slides
cue: Back and forearms on the wall, ribs down; slide up without losing contact.

name: Band Dislocates
cue: Wide grip on a light band; arc it overhead and behind with straight arms.

name: Sleeper Stretch
cue: Lie on the side, upper arm at 90°; ease the forearm down with the other hand.

name: Prone Y-T-W
cue: Face down, thumbs up; lift into a Y, then a T, then a W, squeezing the shoulder blades.

name: Open Books
cue: Side-lying, knees stacked; open the top arm across to the floor behind, eyes follow.

name: Cat-Cow
cue: On hands and knees, round the whole spine up, then arch it down, slowly.

name: Thread the Needle
cue: On all fours, reach one arm under the body, then open it to the ceiling.

name: Foam Roller Thoracic Extensions
cue: Roller across the upper back, hands behind head; extend over it, move up a segment, repeat.

name: Quadruped T-Spine Rotation
cue: On all fours, hand behind head; rotate the elbow down then up to the ceiling.

name: 5-Minute Easy Bike
cue: Easy spin, conversational; just get warm.

name: 5-Minute Easy Row
cue: Easy strokes, legs then back then arms; build gently.

name: Arm Circles
cue: Small to big circles, forwards then backwards.

name: Light Band Pull-Aparts
cue: Light band, straight arms; pull to the chest, squeeze, return slowly.

name: Light Face Pulls
cue: Light stack, rope to the eyes, elbows high, pause at the back.

name: Band External Rotations
cue: Elbow pinned at the side, rotate the forearm out against a light band.

name: Scap Push-Ups
cue: Arms straight in a plank; let the chest sink between the shoulder blades, then push away.

name: Push-Up to Downward Dog
cue: One easy push-up, then push the hips up and back into downward dog.

name: Activation Glute Bridges
cue: Feet flat, drive through the heels, squeeze the glutes at the top.

name: Lateral Band Walks
cue: Band above the knees, half squat; step sideways keeping tension.

name: Lateral Leg Swings
cue: Face a wall, swing one leg across the body and out to the side.

name: Slow Air Squats
cue: Slow bodyweight squats, sitting deeper each rep.

name: Bodyweight Walking Lunges
cue: Long steps, back knee kisses the floor, torso tall.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
cue: Lunge, elbow to the instep, rotate the arm to the ceiling, then straighten the front leg.

name: Doorway Chest Stretch
cue: Forearm on the frame at shoulder height; step through until the chest opens.

name: Lat Stretch
cue: Hold a post or rack, sit the hips back and away; feel it along the side.

name: Child's Pose
cue: Knees wide, sit back to the heels, arms long; breathe into the back.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
cue: Pull the straight arm across the chest just below the shoulder.

name: Upper Trap Stretch
cue: Ear toward shoulder, gentle hand assist, opposite shoulder down.

name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
cue: Hand down the upper back, other hand eases the elbow behind the head.

name: Biceps Wall Stretch
cue: Palm on the wall behind you at shoulder height, thumb up; turn the body away.

name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
cue: Arm straight, palm up; ease the fingers back with the other hand.

name: Cobra Stretch
cue: Face down, hands under shoulders; press the chest up, hips stay down.

name: Standing Quad Stretch
cue: Hold the ankle behind you, knees together, tuck the pelvis.

name: Hamstring Stretch
cue: Straight leg, hinge from the hips with a flat back until it pulls.

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
cue: Half kneeling, squeeze the back glute and shift forward; ribs down.

name: Figure-4 Glute Stretch
cue: On your back, ankle over the opposite knee; pull the thigh in.

name: Butterfly Stretch
cue: Soles together, sit tall, let the knees fall; hinge forward gently.

name: Wall Calf Stretch
cue: Hands on the wall, back leg straight, heel down; lean in.

name: StairMaster Zone 2
cue: Steady pace you could talk through; stand tall, light hands on the rails.

name: StairMaster Intervals
cue: Hard minute, easy minute; let the heart rate fall before the next push.

name: Bike Zone 2
cue: Steady spin at a pace you could hold a conversation at.

name: Bike 30/30 Intervals
cue: 30 seconds hard, 30 easy; keep every hard rep the same power.

name: Rower Zone 2
cue: Steady strokes, about 20 a minute; legs, back, arms.

name: Rower 500 m Repeats
cue: Hold one hard split for every 500; rest easy between.

name: Treadmill Incline Walk
cue: Brisk walk on a steep incline; don't hold the rails.

name: Treadmill Intervals
cue: Fast minute, then walk or jog easy until breathing settles.

name: Outdoor Run
cue: Easy to moderate; you should be able to speak in sentences.

name: Brisk Walk
cue: Purposeful pace, arms swinging; hills welcome.

name: Jump Rope Intervals
cue: Light bounces on the balls of the feet; 30 on, 30 off.
